name: Null

tokens.control_accent: album with picked fallback; contrast-adjust for surface and foreground

null_menu_items.catalog: existing menu destinations and installed apps

null_drawer_state_colours.off: closed palette colour used in both states

null_text_align.label: Text
null_text_align.scope: Null only; all text blocks; drawer entries align within their touch cells; screen hit geometry unchanged

drawer.content: Two text-only menu items per page; no icons. Large 21px 5x7 block glyphs. Blue/red idle, yellow/lime during press; retained destination state must not pretend a pending navigation succeeded.
drawer.anchor: right or left according to handedness
drawer.close: tap reversed arrow or swipe in its shown direction
drawer.secondary_screens: Overlay remains available with faded chrome; exact opacity to be tuned
drawer.visual: Opaque black; glow belongs to edge arrow; thin seams in study only

default_state_pairing.meaning: open/closed visual state pair; not Wi-Fi or playback status

entry_style.glow: light cached glow, crisp pixel foreground

pagination.gesture: Horizontal drag over items scrolls continuously; drag the position handle to scrub the catalog. Outward-close reserved for arrow/edge, not text-drag surface.
pagination.touch_cells: 264x80px combined event surface; text area and lower handle area route separately; outward arrow excluded
pagination.selected_menu: Preserve configurable existing catalog and installed-app entries; source Disco limit is 10 selected entries. 11 pages in study show the full 21-entry catalog, not a new default selection.
pagination.installed_apps: append discovered apps; explicit saved short label or fit-to-width with fallback scrolling; never silently discard destination

handle.input: lower region of drawer; blue/red idle, yellow/lime touched
handle.hold: 350ms at either end begins continuous scrolling at3items/sec; stops at first/last pair
handle.release: 140ms snap to nearest pair; text flick includes momentum
handle.reorder: only TS Menu settings; no accidental reorder while browsing

typography.title: Blocky 5x7 all-caps bitmap; 3px grid; 21px visible height
typography.artist: Same block alphabet; 2px grid; 14px visible height
typography.long_titles: Retain existing delayed scrolling/ellipsis and multilingual fallback

progress.fill: Closed-state blue/red track is replaced by open-state yellow/lime behind the playhead
progress.interaction: Existing seek/scrub semantics; minimum 44px hit region; hit region follows animated control

animation.timing: Cubic ease-out coordinated200ms lift and drawer translation; reverse from current position on interruption
animation.requirement: Content stays visible throughout; no gesture or player-state reset; reverse current animation smoothly on interruption

music.behavior: Existing title/artist tap and hold, track menus, scrubbing, playback actions and gesture behavior retained. Translate their existing objects or synchronize hit areas; no duplicate event handlers.

pixelated_cover.overlay: 60% opaque black, followed by another 10% darkening; effective opacity 64%
pixelated_cover.cache: rebuild once on artwork change, never each frame

background.fixture: original synthetic geometric artwork for preview

transport.buttons: 3 equal 48x48 invisible touch targets at x=96,156,216; blue/red idle, yellow/lime pressed; no border
transport.playing: pause glyph stays yellow/lime during playback; play glyph returns blue/red when paused
transport.mode: Pixel shuffle/repeat/sequential glyph immediately after elapsed/total time; all three shown in preview
transport.autofade: existing Disco semantics: 5s inactivity; touch wakes without triggering transport; mode glyph fades too; 400ms out, 180ms in
transport.gestures: Disco semantics: swipe left previous, swipe right next, double tap play/pause. Small pale-yellow pixel hints. Lower center region, curved screen clipping; bottom Home strip and back edge excluded.
transport.routing: drawer gestures owned within band; scrubbing wins if started on seek control; mode button has priority inside its target; bottom Home strip remains reserved
transport.geometry: Footer compacted to fit: album y235→229, progress255→249, time263→257, buttons288→282. All footer controls lift 6px while opening; title/artist lift 46px.

render_status: Revision9 includes a working standalone LVGL menu event component and pointer-driven host demonstration. Null firmware theme integration, player dispatch binding, live device performance and QS animations remain integration work.

quick_settings.entry: Vertical centered column pulls down from y=-360 to 0; upward swipe dismisses

arrows.colour: yellow/lime while open, same glowing treatment as main navigation arrow
arrows.action: tap or swipe up closes QS

fields.layout: four above and four below, each group a 2x2 grid
fields.pins: Wi-Fi first top-left; Settings last bottom-right
fields.state: blue/red idle; yellow/lime pressed; radio states use existing behavior
fields.hit_regions: Eight fields in two 2x2 groups; 96x44px targets. Cover center48x48; previous/next44x44.

cover.playing: yellow/lime pause glyph with subtle yellow/lime glow around square cover
cover.paused: blue/red play glyph, cover glow off

quick_settings.lifecycle: reuse cached artwork and cached glow; stop hidden panel work; player actions remain existing dispatch
quick_settings.replacement: Supersedes horizontal QS panel; main side nav unchanged
quick_settings.background_motion: Music/NP title, artist and metadata remain fixed; QS occludes them as it passes, never reflows them

transport.style: Borderless pixel glyphs; previous/next blue/red idle, yellow/lime pressed; pause yellow/lime while playing; square cover96x96 with theme-on glow

motion.drag: finger-following; no easing while pointer is down
motion.momentum: exponential decay, bounded velocity; settles to nearest pair
motion.target: LVGL16ms update cadence; actual hardware frame delivery unmeasured
motion.artwork: cache artwork and glow; translation only during panel motion

transport_icons.appearance: hard-edged integer grid; no blur or antialiasing; skip is single stepped triangle plus boundary bar
transport_icons.targets: 48x48 main;44x44 QS previous/next;48x48 QS center; icon children do not consume pointer events
transport_icons.source: null_transport_icons.c/.h; original SVG and transparent PNGs in4palette colours
transport_icons.status: LVGL render/component assets; production firmware integration pending
